practice.prompt: A right triangle has adjacent leg 3 and hypotenuse 5. Find cos θ. Round to the nearest hundredth.
For θ, adjacent leg is 8 and hypotenuse is 17. Evaluate cos θ. Round to the nearest hundredth.
The hypotenuse is 13 and the leg next to θ is 12. What is cos θ? Round to the nearest hundredth.
practice.solution: cos θ = 12/13 ≈ 0.92; identify adjacent, not opposite.

practice.prompt: A right triangle has hypotenuse 20 cm and angle 60°. Find the adjacent leg in cm. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A right triangle has adjacent leg 7 m and angle 45°. Find its hypotenuse in m. Round to the nearest hundredth.
Adjacent side is 6 and hypotenuse 10. Find θ in degrees. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A 13-ft ladder stands with its foot 12 ft from a wall. Find cosine of its angle with the ground. Round to the nearest hundredth.
practice.solution: The ground distance is adjacent: cos θ=12/13≈0.92.

practice.prompt: Find cos 30° minus cos 60°. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A 14-unit segment rises at 30° above horizontal. Find its horizontal projection. Round to the nearest hundredth.
If cos θ=0.8 and the hypotenuse is 15, find the opposite leg. Round to the nearest hundredth.
Similar triangles share angle θ. First has adjacent 6 and hypotenuse 10; second hypotenuse 35. Find its adjacent leg. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A 12-m ladder makes a 40° angle with ground. Find its horizontal distance from wall in m. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A triangle has cos θ=0.75 and hypotenuse 24 cm. Find adjacent leg in cm. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A 17-ft roof brace has a horizontal run of 15 ft. Find its angle above horizontal in degrees. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A right triangle has hypotenuse 26 and side opposite θ length 10. Find cos θ. Round to the nearest hundredth.
Two triangles share angle θ. First adjacent 9 and hypotenuse 15; second hypotenuse 40. Find second adjacent. Round to the nearest hundredth.
A symmetric roof has two 18-m rafters, each at 35° to horizontal. Find total horizontal width in m. Round to the nearest hundredth.
practice.solution: Half-width=18 cos 35°; full width=36 cos 35°≈29.49 m.

practice.prompt: Walk 12 km at 60° above east, then 15 km at 30° above east. Find total eastward displacement in km. Round to the nearest hundredth.
practice.solution: Add horizontal components: 12 cos 60°+15 cos 30°≈18.99 km.
